item.title: Self-Hosted SCEP Certificate Enrollment: micromdm/scep vs jscep vs SCEPy (2026)
item.description: The Simple Certificate Enrollment Protocol (SCEP) automates certificate issuance for network devices, enabling routers, switches, IoT devices, and mobile endpoints to request and renew X.509 certificates without manual intervention. For organizations managing device fleets at scale, self-hosting a SCEP server eliminates dependency on cloud PKI providers while keeping certificate issuance under your control.
